input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. Keep head and torso aimed upper-right away from viewer. Never turn to face the viewer. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete poses. Six resistance poses: ready, lower body braces, forelimbs plant or moth wings fold forward, body withstands force, small effort variation, steady braced hold. No injury or collapse, no shield object or magic effect added to an animal.All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy 2D character animation sprite sheet of a Cinder Hound, set against a solid flat uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. The sheet is arranged in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid of 6 complete poses, separated by wide empty magenta gutters.

Creature description: Quadruped magical beast, a lean low canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide with glowing orange-yellow ember seams along fractures, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, lean hound muzzle, and a compact flickering flame tail. Animal only, four legs, no human elements, no armor, no clothes, no weapons, matching the anatomy and painted style of Reference-1 and Reference-2.

Perspective and angle: Consistent rear-right three-quarter view (northeast angle, head and torso facing diagonally away from the viewer toward the upper-right), viewing the hound's back surfaces, spine, and flanks across all poses. Elevated 55-degree orthographic camera angle. The creature never turns to face the camera.

Six defense and bracing resistance poses across the 3x2 grid:
1. Ready stance (low lean alert quadruped posture, braced rear-right view).
2. Lower body drops and braces backward into a coiled stance.
3. Forelimbs plant firmly into ground, shoulders tense to withstand force.
4. Body absorbs and withstands pressure, arched stone spine and locked hindquarters.
5. Small effort variation, tense rock muscles resisting impact.
6. Steady braced hold, rock limbs planted firm and resolute.

Composition and formatting:
- Exactly 6 poses in a 3x2 grid on pure solid #FF00FF magenta background.
- All 6 bodies at identical anatomical scale, centered within the middle 60% of each cell.
- Wide completely empty magenta gutters between all poses and margins; no overlapping figures.
- Absolutely no text, labels, numbers, grid lines, panel frames, floors, background scenery, magic shield bubbles, or cropped limbs.
- Painterly sculpted volumes, subtle cool rim highlights, glowing ember crevices, smooth digital painting matching visual references.
